english.title: Operator of a non-Part-21 aircraft fail to preserve technical log / approved record
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a non-Part-21 aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed to preserve

(A)_[a technical log]_
(B)_[an approved record]_

relating to that aircraft for at least

(C)_[two years]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), being the period permitted by the CAA]_

after that aircraft had been

(E)_[destroyed]_
(F)_[permanently withdrawn from use]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 227(10) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the operator of a non-Part-21 aircraft,
failed to preserve a technical log or approved record relating to that aircraft
for at least two years or such shorter period as permitted by the CAA
after that aircraft had been destroyed or permanently withdrawn from use
